## Design

### 2026-10-06 – I started with learning KiCad and making a very basic general layout of my board. I mainly worked on the schematic. I haven't decided what parts I want to use yet, but in general i'm thinking an ESP32

**2.1h**

I started with learning KiCad and making a very basic general layout of my board. I mainly worked on the schematic. I haven't decided what parts I want to use yet, but in general i'm thinking an ESP32-S3 due to simplicity of programming.

### 2026-10-09 – Finally made some progress on the board and figured out some components

**10h**

Finally made some progress on the board and figured out some components
Used KiCad's ERC, and after marking a bunch of no connects and fixing small things,

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/3sy9PwwK9xhsgnVGK1zulCWbGXlr58LE/e655eb08c048bbe97b215f09e7dbce8539c4a25c2f1e7df87d9cef3efc907899.png)

Next, PCB designing

Started pretty basic with this:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/3sy9PwwK9xhsgnVGK1zulCWbGXlr58LE/8eb673715008db1a9822574cfb6569d00217da18efecfadae692672c4f5fc6ba.png)

And after I got very comfortable with KiCad's board editor, the final version I'm happy with is this design:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/3sy9PwwK9xhsgnVGK1zulCWbGXlr58LE/6df056caaf64e3a337d4ed5bb0623ea4fa20fab6cdf2c4bc7beb5c927ebb4c70.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/3sy9PwwK9xhsgnVGK1zulCWbGXlr58LE/a139afc5afa690ff9fcc9ee13168086397cce5f4bd774868ee7f9b85141ee34c.png)

I ended up rerouting a few traces so as to not get in the way of the silkscreen art
(initially used a ton of vias on usb data lines so i had to find a different way of running them, not pretty but signal integrity is at least present now)

JLCPCB does not have the SMD components my board requires in stock, and they don't have the required USB C port for my board.
